snippet.title: RUPTURE - Official Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
"Reality has fractured. The Swarm has breached."

Watch the official reveal teaser for RUPTURE, a heavy tactical sci-fi shooter where gravity is broken, and survival is not guaranteed.

Stranded deep within Aegis Sector 4 on the frozen exoplanet Kaelen-9, you are Vanguard-7—a heavily armored Praetorian trapped at the epicenter of a catastrophic spatial anomaly. Fight your way through a collapsing research facility, utilizing zero-gravity combat to outmaneuver a highly intelligent, bio-mechanical alien infection that has assimilated both human flesh and advanced military tech.

The Rupture is open. Will you close it, or be consumed?

🔥 PLAY THE FREE DEMO & WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4603880/Rupture/

Key Features:

Zero-G Firefights: When the facility's gravity fails, the battlefield becomes a 360-degree theater of war. Float, take cover, and return heavy suppressive fire in mid-air.

Bio-Mechanical Threat: The Swarm isn't mindless. They assimilate facility weapons, use squad tactics, and force you into intense, tactical shootouts.

The Walking Tank: You are not a nimble superhero; you are walking artillery. Use heavy weapons and brutal melee executions to shatter the Assimilation.

Developed by: MR SAQLAIN PRODUCTIONS

Join the Community:
